title: POC 1: Hands-on working session & pre-read distribution
text:
POC 1: Hands-on working session & pre-read distribution

From: Jenna Harper <jenna@acme.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: dave.liu@cloudops.io
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on session timing and prep

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. ACME is excited to move into a short hands-on session to validate routing and prompt throughput for our search flow.

Our core asks for the working session:
- Walk through sample prompt set and expected routing rules
- Run a brief load test at 50 concurrent users for 10 minutes to surface any KV cache issues
- Validate embedding/rerank integration with our existing vector store

Do you have availability this week for a 2-hour block? Morning ET tends to work best for our engineers. Also: can you share a short pre-read (slides + checklist) we can distribute internally?

Best,
Jenna
Jenna Harper
Product Manager, ACME Corp

----
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Jenna Harper <jenna@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on session timing and prep

Jenna — thanks for the clear list. We can run that plan. Proposed session outline (2 hours):

1) 15m — Introductions & goals alignment
2) 20m — Prompt review and routing matrix (we'll bring sample prompts)
3) 30m — Live integration walkthrough (embeddings + rerank)
4) 30m — Load test (50 concurrent users, 10m steady-state) with live metrics
5) 15m — Observability review and wrap (latency, token cost, fallback behavior)

Pre-reads we'll attach: a one-page checklist, runbook, sample prompts, and the short slide deck.

Times: I have blocks Tuesday/Wednesday 9:30–12:30 ET. If those don't work we'll shift. Monica (copied) will send the calendar invite and include the pre-reads.

Also quick ask: can ACME share an anonymized sample prompt file (10–20 prompts) so we can validate routing rules ahead of time? If not possible we'll use a representative set.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_POC_Runbook_v1.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: sample_prompts.md (markdown)]

----
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Harper <jenna@acme.com>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 11:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Calendar invite: Redwood x ACME — POC hands-on working session

Hi Jenna — I set a tentative invite for Wednesday, Feb 10, 2027, 10:00–12:00 ET and included a Zoom link. Invite includes: Ben (solutions), Laura (customer success), Priyom (infrastructure).

Pre-reads attached: POC_Slides_ACME_2027-02-08.pptx, Redwood_POC_Runbook_v1.pdf, load_test_plan.csv. Please confirm if the time works or propose an alternate morning slot.

Monica Patel
Solutions Ops | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: POC_Slides_ACME_2027-02-08.pptx]
[Attachment: load_test_plan.csv]

----
From: Jenna Harper <jenna@acme.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Dave Liu <dave.liu@cloudops.io>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 12:15:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Calendar invite: Redwood x ACME — POC hands-on working session

Thanks Monica — quick update: two of our infra leads have a conflict on Wednesday morning and asked if we can move the session to Thursday morning (Feb 11) same time. Apologies for the churn.

We can also share the anonymized prompt file by EOD Tuesday — sending as a separate attachment when available. Would you prefer we include an identity column or strip user identifiers entirely?

Best,
Jenna

----
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Jenna Harper <jenna@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Feb 2027 16:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — hands-on session & pre-read distribution

Jenna — Thursday Feb 11 10:00–12:00 ET works for us. Monica, can you update the invite and include the final prompt file when Jenna sends it?

On the prompt anonymization: please strip any PII and remove user IDs. A simple prompt text column + expected intent label is perfect. That will let us validate routing rules without any sensitive data.

I'll also circulate a short checklist to ACME a few hours before the session so your engineers know what to have ready (API keys, network access to the test VPC, and a small sample dataset for the embedding step).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Ben

[Inline: suggested checklist]
- API key with test scope created
- VPN access to test VPC confirmed
- 10–20 anonymized prompts (CSV) uploaded to shared Drive
- Access to their vector store read-only credentials for rerank tests

----
